name: Average Teaching Dimension of Half-Intervals
proof: For $n\ge2$, the two endpoint initial intervals have one-coordinate teaching sets, while every one of the $n-2$ interior intervals needs and has the adjacent positive/negative pair. Their total is $2+2(n-2)=2n-2$, whose average is $2-2/n$. For $n=1$, the unique concept has the empty teaching set, so the value is zero.
